card.name: First digit of a dose amount
card.fires_on: The first digit of a multi-digit dose number such as 200, 80 or 300 right after a drug name or an opening parenthesis. It is mainly seen in drug interaction and premedication text.

modes.label: Dose digit after drug
modes.description: The leading digit of a dose number written just after a drug name or a bracket, before mg or mcg.
modes.example: Fluticasone propionate aqueous nasal spray (<<2>>00 mcg once

modes.label: Premedication dose
modes.description: The leading digit of a steroid or premedication dose in infusion instructions.
modes.example: Intravenous glucocorticoid: 20 mg dexamethasone or <<8>>0 mg methylprednisolone Hydro

modes.label: Stray non-dose case
modes.description: A rare firing on an ordinary word in a web text sentence.
modes.example: Kanthapura is the story of a village in South India named `Kanthapura` written<< by>> Raja Rao.

card.writes: It promotes opening and closing quote marks and brackets, which does not clearly relate to dose numbers.
card.plain: It fires on the first digit of a dose number, such as the 2 in 200 mg, in drug interaction and premedication text.
